name: resume-timeline
description: Interactive timeline of work experience, projects, and milestones

scripts.build:prod: VITE_DEPLOY_ENV=production vite build && npm run build:post
scripts.build:preview: VITE_DEPLOY_ENV=preview vite build && npm run build:post
scripts.build:post: mv dist/timeline/public/index.html dist/timeline/index.html 2>/dev/null || true && rmdir dist/timeline/public 2>/dev/null || true
